must-read.title: Egypt Flagged Hamas Threat Before Oct. 7
must-read.summary: Atlantic Staff Writer Vivian Salama tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Egypt’s then-intelligence chief Abbas Kamel made an unusual 67-minute trip to Israel less than two weeks before the Oct. 7, 2023, attack to warn Israeli officials that intelligence indicated Hamas was mobilizing for a major assault. AI前沿.title: Why Philosophers Are Worried About AI
AI前沿.summary: Debate over artificial intelligence has largely focused on whether machines could become too powerful. Harvard philosopher Michael Sandel argues that a more immediate question is whether AI changes humans themselves: weakening authentic connection, independent thought and the ways people understand meaning and purpose. Universities are already confronting that challenge as students increasingly use AI to learn and communicate, while Vanderbilt University Chairman Daniel Diermeier argues that technological fluency must be paired with the ability to think independently. (Source: Bloomberg)
AI前沿.title_cn: 为什么哲学家们对人工智能感到担忧
AI前沿.summary_cn: 关于人工智能的争论主要集中在机器是否可能变得过于强大。哈佛哲学家迈克尔·桑德尔认为，更紧迫的问题是人工智能是否改变了人类本身：削弱真实的联系、独立思考以及人们理解意义和目的的方式。大学已经在应对这一挑战，因为学生越来越多地使用人工智能学习和交流，而范德比尔特大学校长丹尼尔·迪尔迈尔认为，技术熟练必须与独立思考的能力相结合。（来源：彭博社）

大国博弈.title_cn: 在首尔就受伤士兵要求道歉后，朝鲜发射了弹道导弹。
大国博弈.summary_cn:
平壤在金正恩妹妹谴责韩国声称朝鲜在非军事区的地雷炸伤韩军后一天向海面发射导弹。

韩日称，朝鲜周六发射了一枚弹道导弹。发射是在朝鲜否认首尔指责其地雷导致韩军受伤的一天后进行的。

韩国军方表示，这枚导弹于上午约6时30分从元山地区发射，飞向东海（即日本海），飞行距离超过700公里（434英里）。首尔和华盛顿正在分析该试验的细节。
大国博弈.ai_summary: 平壤在金正恩妹妹谴责韩国声称朝鲜地雷炸伤韩方士兵后一天向海上发射导弹。韩国和日本表示，朝鲜周六发射了一枚弹道导弹，就在朝鲜驳回韩国指控其地雷炸伤士兵的一天后。韩国军方表示，导弹大约在早上6点30分从元山地区发射，飞向日本海（也称东海），飞行距离超过700公里（434英里）。韩国军方补充说，首尔和华盛顿正在分析这次试验的细节。

产业趋势.title: Fake Jobs Put Job Seekers at Risk of Identity Theft
产业趋势.summary: Fraud investigator Jay Jones, known online as “The Profiler,” tells Bloomberg This Weekend that AI is helping scammers create increasingly convincing fake recruiters and job listings that can lead victims to surrender money and sensitive personal information. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Jones says he has helped remove more than 58,000 fraudulent job listings and advises applicants to verify company websites, domain histories and where application links lead before sharing personal information. (Source: Bloomberg)

投资参考.title: Can AI Outrun America’s Deficit Problem?
投资参考.summary: National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett argues that the economic benefits of AI may be greater than current data show, comparing today’s dynamics with the early internet era, when improvements in computing were difficult to capture in official statistics. At the same time, Hassett says reducing the federal workforce can generate budget savings, and he remains optimistic about economic growth in the face of a growing debt burden. He acknowledges that bringing the federal deficit to 3% of GDP will require more attention. (Source: Bloomberg)
投资参考.title_cn: AI能否跑赢美国的赤字问题？
投资参考.summary_cn: 国家经济委员会主任凯文·哈塞特认为，人工智能的经济效益可能比当前数据显示的更大，他将当今的发展态势与早期互联网时代进行比较，当时计算领域的进步难以在官方统计数据中体现。与此同时，哈塞特表示，削减联邦政府员工可以产生预算节约，面对日益增长的债务负担，他对经济增长仍持乐观态度。他承认，将联邦赤字降至占GDP的3%需要更多关注。（来源：彭博社）
